boundReasoning.barHeightMinimum: Fixed L1 top y=6 plus 0.5 mm enclosure requires h>=4.5; 4.75 adds margin.
boundReasoning.barHeightMaximum: h+g<=8.5 encloses low 6 mm dies below fixed T2 top y=18. h<=6 retains the original g<=2.5 domain.
boundReasoning.dieOffset: ±0.75 mm keeps source coordinate ordering; nearest limiting cuts permit approximately −1<dx<1.
boundReasoning.spineWidth: Fixed L2 enclosure and foreign-copper clearance imply 6.5<=w<=13.5; 7..13 adds margin.

geometry.note: 7^4 domain grid including all 16 corners plus every realized sample; inputs on the required 1 µm lattice. Source topology, finite pads, conservative foreign-copper checks, fixed leads/high dies/ports, and electrical settings checked.
